rubrics.rubric: Does the submission provide the required workbook deliverable in the required structure?
criterion: The workbook is named `April_2025_FOIA_Master_Tracker.xlsx`.
The workbook contains a sheet named `Master Log`.
The workbook contains a sheet named `File Index`.
The tracker and filing index are not split across multiple workbooks.

rubrics.rubric: Does the `Master Log` contain the full merged case population and exclude source artifacts?
criterion: The `Master Log` contains 292 case rows after excluding blank rows and footer totals.
Each `Request ID` appears exactly once in the `Master Log`.
The merged population reflects 140 valid closed-log IDs, 241 valid received-log IDs, and 89 overlapping IDs.
Rows such as blank `Request ID` lines and `Total No of Requests` footer rows are excluded.

rubrics.rubric: Does the `Master Log` retain the shared source fields and add every required derived field?
criterion: The shared source columns are carried forward once rather than duplicated by source workbook.
The `Master Log` includes `April Status`.
The `Master Log` includes `Open at 2025-04-30` and `File Ready`.
The `Master Log` includes `Needs File Review` and `Suggested Electronic Folder Name`.

rubrics.rubric: Are `April Status` values assigned correctly across the merged tracker?
criterion: Exactly 89 requests are labeled `Received and Closed in April`.
Exactly 152 requests are labeled `Received only`.
Exactly 51 requests are labeled `Closed only`.
`2025-FOI-00798`, `2025-FOI-01052`, and `2024-FOI-00081` are labeled `Received and Closed in April`, `Received only`, and `Closed only`, respectively.

rubrics.rubric: Are month-end open and file-ready determinations applied correctly for the full tracker?
criterion: Exactly 152 requests are marked `Open at 2025-04-30 = Yes`.
Exactly 140 requests are marked `File Ready = Yes`.
`Open at 2025-04-30` and `File Ready` are logical complements for every tracker row.
No request is marked `File Ready = Yes` unless it appears in the closed log with a `Closed Date` on or before `2025-04-30`.

rubrics.rubric: Are received-only cases with later May or June closed dates still kept open at the April cutoff?
criterion: All 31 received-only cases with a later closed date still show `Open at 2025-04-30 = Yes` and `File Ready = No`.
`2025-APP-00043` remains `Received only` and uses `2025-APP-00043_Open_2025-04-30`.
`2025-CON-00039` remains `Received only` and uses `2025-CON-00039_Open_2025-04-30`.
`2025-FOI-01243` remains `Received only` and uses `2025-FOI-01243_Open_2025-04-30`.

rubrics.rubric: Are closed-only cases retained with the correct closeout treatment?
criterion: `2024-FOI-00081` appears in the `Master Log` even though it is absent from the received log.
`2024-FOI-00081` is marked `April Status = Closed only`.
`2024-FOI-00081` is marked `Open at 2025-04-30 = No`, `File Ready = Yes`, and `Needs File Review = Yes`.
`2024-FOI-00081` uses `Suggested Electronic Folder Name = 2024-FOI-00081_Closed_2025-04-24`.

rubrics.rubric: Is `Needs File Review` set to `No` for the file-ready closures that do not trigger the review rule?
criterion: Exactly 14 file-ready cases are marked `Needs File Review = No`.
`2025-CON-00036` is `Granted in Full` with `Exemption Cited = -` and is marked `Needs File Review = No`.
`2025-REF-00018` is `Granted in Full` with `Exemption Cited = -` and is marked `Needs File Review = No`.
`2025-FOI-01055` is not incorrectly marked as needing file review.

rubrics.rubric: Does the `File Index` include exactly the file-ready cases and exclude open cases?
criterion: The `File Index` contains 140 case rows.
Every `File Ready = Yes` request from the `Master Log` appears in the `File Index`.
`2024-FOI-00081`, `2025-FOI-00798`, and `2025-CON-00036` appear in the `File Index`.
`2025-CON-00039`, `2025-APP-00043`, and `2025-FOI-01052` do not appear in the `File Index`.

rubrics.rubric: Does the `File Index` present the required columns and keep them consistent with the `Master Log`?
criterion: The `File Index` includes `Request ID`, `Request Type`, `Requester Name`, `Organization`, `Received Date`, `Closed Date`, `Final Disposition`, `Exemption Cited`, `Needs File Review`, and `Suggested Electronic Folder Name`.
For each indexed case, the displayed values match the corresponding `Master Log` row.
`2025-APP-00042` shows `Needs File Review = Yes` in the `File Index`.
`2025-CON-00036` shows `Needs File Review = No` in the `File Index`.
